note: GIMP application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for File, Edit, Select, View, Image, Layer, Colors, Tools, Filters, Windows, Help and their submenus

Dockable dialog frames (Tool Options, Layers, etc.) -- renders fixed operator labels and controls; subtracts the data tables and scroll panes which may contain user-generated layer names or image data
Status bar -- renders fixed operator controls and labels for zoom, grid, and status indicators
